components.name: Primary Civic Button
components.description: Primary CTA reserved for main submission and approval actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #9E2A2B; color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #9E2A2B; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; min-height: 44px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7A1B22; border-color: #7A1B22; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9E2A2B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Civic Record Card
components.description: Flat bordered ledger panel on warm canvas.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; color: #1F1D1B; border: 1px solid #E4E1DC; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-card h4 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; color: #6B6761; }

narrative.overview: G-TRAMS pairs formal Philippine municipal authority with legible, resilient digital record-keeping across five civic roles.
keyCharacteristics: Warm limestone-and-paper neutrals with zero cool slate drift.
Precision tabular numerals via IBM Plex Mono.
Strictly 4 semantic status bands with WCAG AA text-and-icon pairing.
Restrained 1px hairline borders rather than drop-shadow haze.

rules.name: The One-Accent Landmark Rule
rules.body: Gasan Maroon occupies primary landmarks and primary actions only.

rules.name: The Tabular Ledger Rule
rules.body: All currency, plate codes, OR numbers, and counts use font-mono tabular-nums.

dos: Do use warm #F6F5F3 / #14110F / #1C1917 / #2E2A27 neutrals on every panel, modal, and skeleton.
Do validate >= 4.5:1 normal text contrast and >= 3:1 UI border/icon contrast across Light & Dark themes.
Do enforce 44px minimum touch targets on mobile triggers and convert wide <768px tables into readable stacked cards.
donts: Don't use Tailwind numeric neutral-* classes, slate-* cool grays, or invalid TWv4 classes.
Don't place thick border-l-4 left accent borders on cards or callouts, or use animate-bounce on floating widgets.
Don't expose native browser alert(), window.confirm(), or window.prompt() popups.
